title: Human Reproduction
seo_title: Human Reproduction Class 12 Biology Worksheet with Answers (NCERT Chapter 2)
standard_text: Male and female reproductive systems; microscopic anatomy of testis and ovary; gametogenesis – spermatogenesis and oogenesis; menstrual cycle; fertilisation, embryo development up to blastocyst formation, implantation; pregnancy and placenta formation (elementary idea); parturition (elementary idea); lactation (elementary idea).
meta_desc: Free CBSE Class 12 Biology worksheets for NCERT Chapter 2 Human Reproduction: male and female reproductive systems, gametogenesis, the menstrual cycle, fertilisation, implantation, placenta, parturition and lactation. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Spermatogenesis gives four sperms; oogenesis gives one ovum.
key_sub: LH surge → ovulation; progesterone keeps the uterus ready.
body_html:
How to think about it

The testes make sperms (spermatogenesis) and testosterone; Sertoli cells nourish developing sperms and Leydig cells make hormones. The ovaries make ova (oogenesis), one ovum and polar bodies from each primary oocyte. In the 28-day menstrual cycle FSH and oestrogen build the follicle and endometrium, an LH surge causes ovulation around day 14, and the corpus luteum makes progesterone.

Fertilisation usually happens in the ampulla of the oviduct. The zygote divides to form a blastocyst that implants in the endometrium; the placenta exchanges materials and makes hormones such as hCG. Parturition is helped by oxytocin, and lactation provides colostrum rich in antibodies.

Example

100 primary spermatocytes → sperms?

× 4

Answer: 400

Example

Hormone surge for ovulation?

mid-cycle

Answer: LH

Common mistakes

  • Saying one primary oocyte gives four ova.
  • Putting fertilisation in the uterus.
  • Mixing up Sertoli and Leydig cells.

faq.q: What happens in the menstrual cycle if the egg is not fertilised?
faq.a: The corpus luteum breaks down, progesterone falls and the endometrium is shed as menstruation.

faq.q: Where does fertilisation take place in humans?
faq.a: Usually in the ampulla of the fallopian tube (oviduct).

items.q: A woman has a regular menstrual cycle of 26 days. Ovulation usually happens about 14 days before the next period. On about which day of the cycle does she ovulate?
items.e: Day of ovulation ≈ cycle length − 14 = 26 − 14 = day 12.
